# Power Systems Wiki

> An open, cited reference for power systems engineering terminology, created by Jinning Wang and maintained with community contributions.

Canonical site: https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/

Power Systems Wiki compares definitions from papers, standards, and industry reports. Term pages are secondary reference pages; follow their citations when a primary source is required.

## Browse

- [All terms](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/wiki/): Alphabetical index of terminology pages.
- [Tags](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/tags/): Terms grouped by subject.
- [About and usage guidance](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/): Purpose, scope, and suggestions for using the wiki.

## Machine-readable access

- [Term index](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/api/index.json): Searchable metadata for all terms.
- [Term JSON](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/terms/voltage-stability.json): Example complete term record. Replace `voltage-stability` with a term ID.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/api/openapi.yaml): REST API contract.
- [REST API documentation](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/rest-api/): Endpoints and examples.
- [MCP server documentation](https://ps-wiki.ning.guru/mcp/): Tools for AI assistants and MCP clients.

## Attribution and interpretation

- Preserve links or citations to the original sources when summarizing a definition.
- Distinguish between definitions from different organizations instead of merging them into a single authoritative definition.
- The wiki content is available under [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://github.com/ps-wiki/ps-wiki.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE).
